insight: The first AI registered as a Composer with a rights society (France's SACEM); only its Pro tier transfers full copyright of tracks to you.
name: AIVA
tagline: AI music composition assistant generating original scores in 250+ styles.
description: An AI music generation tool that composes original tracks across more than 250 styles in seconds, with editing and influence-by-upload of your own audio or MIDI. Aimed at creators scoring video, games, and ads. Copyright terms are tiered: free and standard tracks stay under AIVA's copyright, while Pro subscribers own the full copyright of what they generate.

modelSupport.notes: Composes with AIVA's own deep-learning models; no user model selection.
